correctness.rationale: Classical spherical branching H_4(S3)=⊕_{m=0}^4 H_m(S2) and probability-normalized s-coordinate measure 2sqrt(1-s²)/pi reduce the trace eigenvalues to (1-u)^m[C_(4-m)^(m+1)(sqrt u)]²/N_m with N=(1,6,63/8,7/2,63/128). This gives the five stated polynomial eigenvalue branches with multiplicities 2m+1. Independently expanded the trace identity sum(2m+1)lambda_m≡25 symbolically. Symbolic factorization lambda_1-lambda_2 = -8(u-1)(640u³-576u²+114u-3)/21 yields crossing tau in (6/25,1/4). Source exact monotonicity on [1/8,tau], [tau,7/25] and rational upper bounds <11/20 on [0,1/8] and [7/25,1] establish the global maximin; remaining branches exceed the active minimum at tau. Independent symbolic crossing and numerical evaluation give tau=0.2405728168548298, λ1=λ2=0.563450274180078, other branches approx .92327, 1.92671, .67579, giving precisely 3+5=8 least modes. Finite numerical values do not replace the polynomial and interval proof.
